name: Define PGlite Drizzle schema for diagnostic packets and dharma ledger
description: Create Drizzle ORM schema files for all PGlite tables. Intelligence-layer: diagnostic_packets (JSONB, vector embeddings), dharma_ledger (ACID transactions), identity_mappings, packet_provenance, confirmation_chains. Coordination-kernel lifecycle: WorkItemTable (enqueue_pending, in_progress, completed, failed_terminal, failed_retryable, dead_lettered), WorkAttemptTable (attempt lifecycle tracking), DeadLetterTable (terminal dead-letter records), QuarantineTable (unknown stream entry quarantine), recovery_receipts (rebuild audit trail). Every row gets event_id, schema_version, created_at. Use additionalProperties:false at DB level.
